scope: First-pass non-search engine audit: independent local operation kernels, allocation census and correctness probes. No production candidate integrated.
candidate_definition: Alternative functions/representations in standalone audit examples against the same engine revision; source hashes are recorded.

environment.cpu_affinity_frequency_thermal_controls: Not specified in raw outputs; these short local screens are sensitive to host conditions.
environment.timing_coordination: Parent coordinated serial audit timing jobs; no search workload was executed.

statistics.time_unit: nanoseconds per case-defined logical batch (timed loop mean in each repetition)
statistics.batch_definition: The workload.batch_definition for each case defines exactly what one recorded time covers. A batch can be a whole move list, a 4096-probe list, one target query or one load.
statistics.summary: Median of per-repetition batch means for each arm; ratio summaries are median/min/max of paired candidate_batch_ns/baseline_batch_ns.
statistics.ratio_direction: Less than 1 is lower candidate time. Ratio of arm medians can differ from median paired ratio.
statistics.uncertainty: Observed paired-repetition range only; no confidence interval, individual-operation p95/p99 or workload-level latency distribution is inferred.
statistics.aggregation_policy: No elapsed times, ratios or speedups are aggregated across unlike cases. Historical same-session controls are kept separate from primary runs.
statistics.precision: Ratios are recomputed from the raw recorded ns values, not the lower-precision printed ratio column.

size_limitations: Board size824 is inline fields only and excludes heap square/slot/army/royal storage. Vec/route heap storage is excluded from size_of values.
